contract: POST /api/watcher/update is admin-only and forwards one filesystem change to the library watcher: type add, unlink or rename (rename also needs oldPath). A change the watcher cannot or must not watch is accepted with 200 and queues nothing.
exceptions: Historical verification claims are retained only in the archived pre-2026-11-13 record; they do not establish current named-test coverage or invariant verification.
Stateful operation: scenario evidence is not yet independently reconciled for each listed transition.

Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
force is not applicable: the route has no force, hard or override parameter.

invariants.contract: The route answers 401 without a token, 403 to a non-admin before the body is checked, and 400 when libraryId, path or type is missing, when type is not add, unlink or rename, or when a rename has no oldPath. An unknown library id, a path outside every library folder and an ignored dotfile still answer 200 and queue no scan task.
exceptions: Named tests listed are relevant package-level current tests; their assertions do not yet prove every route branch or the complete upstream contract.

invariants.contract: A queued change emits task_started (action watcher-scan, data.libraryId and data.libraryName, title key MessageTaskScanningFileChanges and the library name as substitution, not finished) to every authenticated socket, admin or not; the task is listed by GET /api/tasks for that library, and when the debounce elapses the scanner emits task_finished with the same id, no failure, zero added, updated and removed files, and no library row changes.
exceptions: Named tests listed are relevant package-level current tests; their assertions do not yet prove every route branch or the complete upstream contract.

invariants.contract: Posting the same change twice answers 200 both times and queues exactly one watcher-scan task for the library.
exceptions: Current test names are discovery anchors; repeated-operation outputs need explicit assertion mapping.
